info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Partner Authentication API
info.description: The Partner Authentication API facilitates secure authentication for partners within the microservice ecosystem. Using this endpoint, partners can register their credentials, enabling seamless access to the system's resources. This API is essential for implementing robust security measures and ensuring authenticated interactions. It is typically utilized by partner integrations requiring access to protected resources in environments where secure transactions are critical.

post.description: This endpoint allows partners to authenticate themselves by providing their credentials. A successful authentication will return a token that can be used for subsequent requests.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to authenticate a partner using their credentials. Ensure that the required fields are filled out correctly to obtain a valid authentication token.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a JSON Web Token (JWT) to authenticate and authorize requests. Clients must include a valid JWT in the 'Authorization' header using the Bearer prefix.
